name.ja: HG 1/72 境界戦機ウェポンセット2

description.ja: 『境界戦機』シリーズの武装を集約したウェポンセットが登場！さまざまな機体と組み合わせてプラモデルオリジナルのアレンジを楽しもう！
description.en: Introducing a Weapon set that combines the weapons of the "Kyoukai Senki" series! Enjoy the original arrangement of the plastic model by combining it with various aircraft!

description.ja: ■超熱振式戦闘長刀、40mm携行短機関砲、超熱振式薙刀改、45mm回転式装甲機関砲など主人公機に付属する武装をまとめたセット。
description.en: • A set that compiles the weapons that come with the main character's machine, such as the super-heat-type combat long sword, 40mm portable submachine gun, super-heat-type naginata Kai, and 45mm rotary armored machine gun.

accessories.en: Super heat wave combat long sword x 1
Super heat wave type naginata Kai x 1

accessories.ja: （背部懸架型）多連装小型誘導弾発射機×１式
accessories.en: (back suspension type) multiple small guided missile launcher x 1 set
